name: Omae no Kaa-chan, Mesu Buta Niku Benki ni Nattenzo?
original_name: お前の母ちゃん、メス豚肉便器になってんぞ?
source:
My mom had been hypnotized.
She was convinced that some sleazy guy was the love of her life.
Her thoughts manipulated, she started taking on ridiculous part-time jobs.

"Hypnosis…? That’s ridiculous!!
Please, Mom!! Snap out of it!!"

But my pleas fell on deaf ears.
She trampled over the promises she’d made to my dad, betrayed his trust, and the once-clearheaded woman I knew transformed into something unrecognizable—a shameless, lewd bitch.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ085772.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
我妈被催眠了。
她深信某个猥琐的男人就是自己一生的挚爱。
思想遭到操控后，她开始干起各种荒唐的兼职。

“催眠……？开什么玩笑！
妈，求你了！快清醒过来！”

可我的哀求根本传不进她耳中。她践踏了对父亲许下的承诺，背叛了他的信任。那个曾经头脑清醒、我无比熟悉的女人，最终变成了一个面目全非、恬不知耻的淫妇。
